claims: The 130th Boston Marathon is on Monday, April 20, 2026.
The 130th Boston Marathon features a six-wave start.
The 130th Boston Marathon Men's Wheelchair division starts at 9:06 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Women's Wheelchair division starts at 9:09 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Handcycles & Duo Participants start at 9:30 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Professional Men start at 9:37 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Professional Women start at 9:47 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Para Athletics Division starts at 9:50 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Wave 1 starts at 10:00 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Wave 2 starts at 10:15 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Wave 3 starts at 10:28 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Wave 4 starts at 10:41 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Wave 5 starts at 11:01 a.m. EDT.
The 130th Boston Marathon Wave 6 starts at 11:21 a.m. EDT.
The starting line of the 130th Boston Marathon is in Hopkinton.
All participants in the 130th Boston Marathon are expected to be across the starting line by approximately 11:30 a.m.
